record.question: When converting a star resistive network to an equivalent delta network, if all the three resistors are equal in value, then the value of the resultant resistors in the equivalent delta network will be
options: same as that of star resistors
2 times the value of the star resistors
3 times the value of the star resistors
4 times the value of the star resistors
record.explanation: In star-to-delta conversion, when all three star resistors have equal value R_s, each delta resistor R_d = 3 × R_s.
